Terms.title: Salon Membership Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro: Thank you for choosing Love You Nail Salon. Our membership program is designed to provide ongoing beauty and wellness services at exclusive member pricing. By purchasing a membership, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to the following Terms & Conditions.

sections.title: One-Year Membership Commitment
paragraphs: All salon memberships are sold as a 12-month (one-year) commitment beginning on the date of purchase.
By enrolling, you are entering into a binding membership agreement for the full membership term.
Membership benefits are intended for use throughout the one-year commitment and are available only to the enrolled member.

sections.title: No Refund Policy
paragraphs: ALL MEMBERSHIP SALES ARE FINAL.
Once a membership agreement has been executed, the member is financially responsible for the full one-year commitment.
Purchasing a membership constitutes your acknowledgment and acceptance of this strict no-refund policy.

sections.title: Membership Payments
paragraphs: Members are responsible for making all scheduled membership payments as agreed at the time of enrollment.
If the membership is financed through monthly installments, the payment obligation remains in effect for the entire 12-month term.
Failure to use membership services does not relieve the member of their payment obligations.

sections.title: Non-Transferable Membership
paragraphs: Memberships are issued to the individual purchaser only and cannot be transferred, shared, or assigned to another individual, and have no cash value.

sections.title: Appointment Policy
paragraphs: Membership services are provided by appointment only and are subject to salon availability. Members are encouraged to schedule appointments in advance.
Our standard cancellation and no-show policies apply to all membership appointments.

sections.title: Salon Rights
paragraphs: The salon reserves the right to suspend or terminate membership privileges for misuse of benefits, fraudulent activity, abusive behavior toward staff or clients, or violations of salon policies. Such termination does not entitle the member to any refund, credit, or release from any remaining payment obligations.

sections.title: Policy Changes

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At Love You Nail Salon, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect personal details such as your name, phone number, and email address when you book an appointment or contact us. This information is used solely to manage your appointments, send confirmations and reminders (via email or SMS), and provide the best possible service.

sections.title: Text Messaging
paragraphs: By providing your phone number, you consent to receive SMS messages regarding your appointments, including confirmations, reminders, and updates. You may opt out of SMS communications at any time by replying “STOP.”

sections.title: Data Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties, except as necessary to operate our booking systems (such as Square and Fresha) or as required by law.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to safeguard your data.

sections.title: Your Rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. Please contact us at loveyounailsalon@gmail.com for any data-related inquiries.

sections.title: Policy Updates
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The most recent version will always be available on our website.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: If you have any questions about this policy, please email us at loveyounailsalon@gmail.com.

Salon.title: Salon Policy
Salon.intro: At Love You, we strive to provide our clients with exceptional service in a professional and welcoming environment. To ensure a smooth experience for everyone, please review our salon policies.

sections.title: Appointments
paragraphs: Scheduling: Appointments can be made online, via phone, or in-person. We recommend booking in advance, especially during peak times.

sections.title: No-Show, Late Cancellation & Rescheduling
paragraphs: Please cancel or reschedule your appointment at least 24 hours in advance to avoid being charged. Appointments canceled or rescheduled within 24 hours will be charged 100%. If you are more than 15 minutes late for your appointment, you will be considered a no-show and charged in full for the services you reserved. All sales are final.

sections.title: Payment
paragraphs: Accepted Payments: We accept credit/debit cards and gift certificates. Payment is due at the time of service.
Gratuity: Gratuity is not included in the service price. If you enjoyed your service, a tip for your technician is appreciated.
A deposit may be required for certain services or appointments.
Prices are non-negotiable and subject to change without prior notice.
Gift cards and vouchers must be presented at the time of payment.

sections.title: Refund Policy
paragraphs: Refunds will only be issued in the form of store credit.
Refund requests must be made within 24 hours of the service being rendered.
Refunds will not be provided for gift cards, vouchers, or products purchased.

sections.title: Services
paragraphs: Consultations: We encourage consultations before any service to discuss your preferences and expectations.
Satisfaction Guarantee: Your satisfaction is our priority. If you are not satisfied with your service, please let us know within 7 days so we can address your concerns.
Service Modifications: We reserve the right to modify services based on the condition of your nails and skin. Your technician will provide recommendations.

sections.title: Health & Safety
paragraphs: Health Concerns: Please inform us of any allergies, sensitivities, or medical conditions prior to your appointment.
We adhere to all local health and safety guidelines to ensure the well-being of our clients and staff.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: For the comfort and safety of all our clients, we ask that children are supervised at all times. We cannot be responsible for any accidents.

sections.title: Behavior
paragraphs: Respectful Environment: We maintain a respectful and professional environment. Any inappropriate behavior or language will not be tolerated and may result in termination of services.
Personal Belongings: Please keep your belongings with you. We are not responsible for lost or stolen items.

sections.title: Changes to Policy
paragraphs: We reserve the right to amend our policies at any time. Any changes will be communicated to our clients.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: For any questions or clarifications regarding our policies, please contact your nearest studio or email us at loveyounailsalon@gmail.com. Thank you for choosing Love You Nail Salon — we look forward to serving you!

sections.title: Right to Refuse Service
paragraphs: We reserve the right to refuse service to anyone who is under the influence of drugs or alcohol, behaves aggressively or inappropriately, or creates unsafe conditions for our staff or other clients.

sections.title: Group Bookings & Deposits
paragraphs: For parties of 3 or more, we require a deposit equal to 50% of the total of all services, or the price of several services. Which of these policies applies is decided individually, on a case-by-case basis. The deposit is applied toward your final total once services are complete.

Sterilization.title: Our Sterilization Process
Sterilization.lead: Your safety and hygiene are our top priorities.
Sterilization.intro1: At LOVE YOU Nail Salon, every location is equipped with a designated sterilization zone, where our professional tools undergo a thorough cleaning, disinfection, and sterilization process.
Sterilization.intro2: We use professional Tuttnauer autoclaves, which use high-pressure saturated steam to sterilize our reusable metal instruments after every client, following established hygiene and safety protocols.

steps.title: Pre-Cleaning
steps.body: Immediately after each service, reusable metal instruments are collected and thoroughly cleaned to remove visible residue, dust, and organic matter.

steps.title: Disinfection
steps.body: The cleaned instruments undergo a disinfection process using professional-grade solutions designed for salon tools, following the manufacturer's recommended concentration and contact time.

steps.title: Drying & Packaging
steps.body: After cleaning and disinfection, instruments are thoroughly rinsed when required, dried, inspected, and sealed in specialized sterilization pouches to help maintain their sterility after processing.

steps.title: Autoclave Sterilization
steps.body: The packaged instruments are placed inside our Tuttnauer steam autoclaves, where they undergo a sterilization cycle using pressurized steam at controlled temperatures to eliminate microorganisms, including bacterial spores.

steps.title: Safe Storage
steps.body: Once the sterilization cycle is successfully completed and the instruments are dry, sealed pouches are stored in a clean, designated area until their next use.

Sterilization.freshTitle: A fresh set for every client
Sterilization.freshBody: Every client receives a freshly sterilized set of reusable metal instruments. Sterilization pouches remain sealed until the tools are ready to be used, helping maintain hygienic conditions throughout every appointment.
Sterilization.closing: Because beautiful nails should always begin with safe, professional care.
Sterilization.metaTitle: Our Sterilization Process | Love You Nail Salon
Sterilization.metaDescription: How Love You Nail Salon sterilizes every reusable metal tool: pre-cleaning, disinfection, sealed pouches and Tuttnauer steam autoclaves — a fresh set for every client.

why.technique: Russian e-file manicure by trained specialists — precise, gentle cuticle work and a long-lasting, glossy finish.

why.membership: Members save 10–15% on every service and get a free nail fix within 14 days — valid at all participating studios.

west-loop.seoTitle: Nail Salon in West Loop, Chicago — Russian Manicure | Love You
west-loop.seoDescription: Love You Nail Salon West Loop at 118 N Halsted St, near Randolph Street & Fulton Market. Russian e-file manicure and smart pedicure, open 7 days. Book online.
west-loop.intro: Our West Loop studio is on Halsted Street, a short walk from Randolph Street's Restaurant Row and the Fulton Market district — easy to fit in before dinner or after work. Come in for a Russian e-file manicure, a smart pedicure or a full mani-pedi with two technicians at once.
west-loop.transit: The closest “L” station is Morgan (Green & Pink Lines), about a 7-minute walk. The #8 Halsted bus stops near the studio.

lake-view.seoTitle: Nail Salon in Lakeview, Chicago — Russian Manicure | Love You
lake-view.seoDescription: Love You Nail Salon Lakeview at 2829 N Clark St, near Clark & Diversey. Russian e-file manicure and smart pedicure, open 7 days. Book online.
lake-view.intro: Our Lakeview studio sits on Clark Street just north of Diversey Parkway, among the neighborhood's shops and cafés and a few minutes from the lakefront. It's an easy weekend stop for a fresh set or a relaxing smart pedicure.
lake-view.transit: CTA buses #22 Clark and #76 Diversey stop nearby; the Diversey Brown Line station is about a 10-minute walk.

wicker-park.seoTitle: Nail Salon in Wicker Park, Chicago — Russian Manicure | Love You
wicker-park.seoDescription: Love You Nail Salon Wicker Park at 1843 W North Ave, near North, Damen & Milwaukee. Russian e-file manicure and smart pedicure, open 7 days. Book online.
wicker-park.intro: Our Wicker Park studio is on North Avenue, just east of the six-corner intersection of North, Damen and Milwaukee — the heart of the neighborhood's boutiques, coffee shops and restaurants. Pair your nail appointment with an afternoon in one of Chicago's liveliest neighborhoods.
wicker-park.transit: The Damen Blue Line station is about a 5-minute walk. The #72 North bus stops nearby.

river-north.seoTitle: Nail Salon in River North, Chicago — Russian Manicure | Love You
river-north.seoDescription: Love You Nail Salon River North at 353 W Chicago Ave, steps from the Chicago Brown Line station. Russian e-file manicure and smart pedicure, open 7 days.
river-north.intro: Our River North studio is on Chicago Avenue in one of the city's busiest dining and gallery neighborhoods, close to downtown offices and hotels. It's a convenient spot for a lunchtime manicure or a polished look before an evening out.
river-north.transit: The Chicago station (Brown & Purple Lines) is about a 2-minute walk. The #66 Chicago bus stops nearby.

downtown.seoTitle: Nail Salon in Downtown Chicago — Russian Manicure | Love You
downtown.seoDescription: Love You Nail Salon Downtown at 180 N Jefferson St, near Ogilvie Transportation Center. Russian e-file manicure and smart pedicure, open 7 days. Book online.
downtown.intro: Our Downtown studio is at Jefferson and Lake Street on the west edge of the Loop, a short walk from Ogilvie Transportation Center — convenient for commuters and anyone working downtown. Book a quick manicure before your train or a full mani-pedi after work.
downtown.transit: The Clinton station (Green & Pink Lines) is about a 2-minute walk, and Ogilvie Transportation Center (Metra) about 6 minutes.
